- Bacterial_Stalk_Rot: Shows fully collapsed brown stalks, not node-specific blackening
- Charcoal_Stalk_Rot: Shredded pith with tiny sclerotia, dry appearance
- Diplodia_Stalk_Rot: Dry, tan/brown stalk
- Anthracnose: Dry stalk with shiny black areas
- All leaf diseases (Gray_Leaf_Spot, Northern_Leaf_Blight, Tar_Spot, Common_Rust, Southern_Rust): Wrong plant part entirely
- Purple_Leaf_Sheath, Physoderma_Brown_Spot, Common_Smut: Wrong appearance
